product_metadata.title: Mocoosy 4 Bunches Artificial Sunflowers Bouquets, Fake Silk Sunflowers with Stems for Decorations, Yellow Faux Sun Flowers Bulk Arrangements for Wedding Birthday Party Home Decor
features: PACKAGE INCLUDING: 4 artificial sunflower bouquets, each with 7 branches, and contains some realistic leaves and white floret. The bouquet is 12.6 inches long and each flower diameter is 4.3 inches with brown center, rhubarb petals. These fake sunflowers are vibrant and give character to your table.

PREMIUM MATERIAL: Made of high quality silk and plastic, realistic artificial sunflowers with stems. It is not easy to tear and without obvious smell. The stem contains iron wire, not easy to break. Good volume and stems can be bent for adjustment to fit your vase or pot.

PERFECT FOR HOME DECOR: High degree of simulation, a wonderful choice for living room or dining table. You don't need to spend a lot of time to maintain the faux sunflower bouquets, it will add a lot of sunshine color to your center pieces without breaking your decor.

WONDERFUL DIY CHOICE: All these silk sun flowers are flexible and detachable, you just need to glue or sew them on the project the way you like. Even if you are allergic to real flowers, you can still put these silk sunflowers bouquets any other place that you want to decorate.

WIDE APPLICATIONS: Perfect for landscaping projects or any decor style, not easy to deform even after you give light pressure. Artificial flowers can be used in country yards, stores, front porch, balcony. Decoration for embellishing weddings, table decor, parties, fall arrangement, Thanksgiving, Christmas or any special festival occasions etc. Add details to events.
